description: List customer addresses with optional filters (customer, ids, created/updated date ranges). Returns { addresses }. Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` (default 50, max 250) and read `next_cursor` / `previous_cursor` from the response. IMPORTANT: when paging with `cursor`, Recharge accepts ONLY `limit` alongside it — omit every other filter on cursor requests. Recharge REST: GET /addresses.

created_at_max.description: Filter to addresses created on/before this date (ISO 8601).

created_at_min.description: Filter to addresses created on/after this date (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor / previous_cursor from a prior response). Use it ALONE with `limit` — omit all other filters on cursor requests.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of address ids to fetch.

updated_at_max.description: Filter to addresses updated on/before this date (ISO 8601).

updated_at_min.description: Filter to addresses updated on/after this date (ISO 8601).

name: recharge_list_addresses
title: List addresses
